campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine: Priority: improve robustness and cut gate, automation and runtime wall time and peak memory by consolidating duplicated logic into fewer general components, never by adding instrumentation or a framework. Net AST nodes stay flat or fall: every addition deletes at least as much, a new general component replaces the copies it subsumes, and the clone and harness ratchets hold the floor. Do safe, behavior-preserving consolidations first, the ones existing tests and the ratchets already cover; take deeper execution-core and command-surface simplification behind the model-regression baseline so a removal never loses proven behavior. Preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework. Preserve acceptance and independent model progress; these priorities add no automation prerequisite to model validation. Document order ranks ready work; depends_on names actual producers. A step's machine check is its verify, set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. GUI and audio retain their lanes. Master execution proceeds under role master-lead. docs/plan.json is the sole live plan.

items.title: Satisfy matching acceptance and owner obligations once

steps.title: Reuse one owner execution for matching named acceptance
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: only coalesce executions with matching test/profile/input contracts. The merge 430431e8 acceptance cost 1.361s versus owners 3m21.809s; this boundary is worthwhile only after identifying a representative implementation row with actual duplicated execution. Reuse the new analysis product; do not rebuild graph discovery or conflate filtered acceptance with full-package coverage.

Owners: gate, planverify, testevidence and automationcheck. Baseline: fd153b33 acceptance 3m35.277s, owners 3m26.575s; suite evidence:sha256:399a5dff00420c3b6379d4407e33b48cad87ec5cf86596055bc7cd5f954555d1. Identify exact overlapping invocations before changing scheduling. Start with the existing finite Go-test grammar and matching owner profile; unsupported commands keep their existing path. Plan obligations before execution. One complete owner run may discharge matching named acceptance; a filtered pass never proves the whole package. Bind setup/cleanup, subtests, flags, environment, fixtures and declared ordering. Prove required tests actually run and pass. Counterexamples: absent/renamed/skipped or failed tests, changed inputs, short/full mismatch, tampered receipts, cancellation and interruption around publication. Preserve independent passes across restart without granting missing package credit. Demonstrate one real overlap executes once with the same verdict and report total cycle cost. Delete the duplicate execution path; do not add another runner.

Named-execution-receipts supplies the previously missing durable named outcomes. Use those authoritative receipts, never suite-cost diagnostics. Preserve the immutable host repeat policy: one execution cannot stand in for two observations. Unsupported commands, unmatched setup/cleanup or ordering, changed flags/fixtures/environment, missing names and incompatible short/full profiles keep their existing execution path. Audio intake now names the four existing acceptance owners after fa8745cb and bedb9e93 removed duplicate wrappers; do not reintroduce those wrappers.

9f133f6e delivers named receipts; no duplicate execution is removed yet. Finding evidence:sha256:3104d8504378e9fc4e5aec49cbe25f226e576d3a3a1013350a149f7f0654a7c3 retains executed setup-order and selector-sensitive counterexamples: full-package passes cannot alone substitute for filtered acceptance. The environment descriptor also binds external data locations, not artifact bytes. Establish a matching execution-context and immutable-fixture proof for a real target, then measure saved executions; unknown cases retain execution. Keep this step open and let ready model acceptance proceed without another prerequisite or receipt-only slice.

Priority: deliver an actual eliminated invocation, not another receipt-only layer. Include the complete gate process tree in the comparison: avoiding one duplicate model load or package process should lower both peak live memory and wall cost. No reuse based only on names, a coincidentally passing output, or allocation pressure; preserve the retained selector/setup counterexamples.

items.title: Resume deferred verification from retained prepared work

steps.title: Carry immutable selections into the deferred runner
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: persist already-composed selections for restart, without changing scheduler policy or cross-recipe receipt eligibility. 430431e8 ran lanes inline; plan-only a674e353 still spent 41.2s resolving a deferred lane with no test execution. First prove that redundant reconstruction can be removed for that bounded case while preserving all obligations.

Owners: deferred_lanes and existing runrecord/automationcheck evidence. The runner repeats planPipeline and stepTestPlan. fd153b33 deferred result evidence:sha256:2b8d3d0c010ce97aa77b9a5f04e2340d5b048f5732443aea9f50f8c3e3dec49d cost 361.2s; do not attribute all of it to reconstruction. Extend the existing obligation/manifest with minimal prepared execution inputs, not a second graph. Prove the mapping between pre-publication and committed trees, including plan advancement and generated documents. Recheck live environment, policy, resources, source drift and evidence availability. Missing/incompatible prepared data uses conservative reconstruction. Counterexamples: death around commit/result writes, changed checkout/plan, corrupt selection, lost cache, analyzer changes and concurrent terminal publication. Demonstrate one restart avoids discovery while preserving every owed lane and exact executable lifetime.

Memory boundary: retain compact source-bound selections and artifact references, not duplicate AST/type graphs, inventories or raw result streams in parent and child. Load only selected obligations; release preparation state before expensive execution when it is no longer used. Compare cold and resumed whole-process-tree peaks and full completion wall. Reuse the gate-resource-efficiency accounting; this row owns prepared-state lifetime, not another memory governor.

items.title: Determine unnecessary testing and deliver one measured gate reduction

steps.title: Review retained integration evidence and decide first-reduction adoption
steps.rationale:
Current priority evidence: master 964838b7 gate result evidence:sha256:bfada10772abe7dde300a4d9be5fb5fa3b67f06804e408c7d43d148d96bbb723, cost evidence:sha256:35c7d20fa361218bcc1927d360fbd76c32276b4932beb25218b99176d5f0c687 and selection evidence:sha256:a52c07bdae22ef86844b455998b7ff925159e37e56bd1784823bc8ea02bc188e. Successful wall 1408.6s, device 9m4.142s, 235 selected packages; nine immutable phases reused, but selection still broad. Prior failed result evidence:sha256:02532237e32d5040551d8bef6a80cb553e8aa33729610b89636b2e69b25033ed cost 1301.9s. Reconstruct actual executed/reused/unstarted work; selected counts are not executed counts and these different candidates are not a matched speedup. Use retained records first. Extend the existing single payback decision with peak memory, allocations and bytes transferred when available; absent measurements remain unknown. Prioritize a real repeated-cost reduction over more graph infrastructure.

Combined-plan boundary: one read-only decision over retained before/after executions and the frozen counterexamples. Include actual 430431e8 execution evidence:sha256:1081d436a53cee4575717f4dc89d5d02b591a7dad747091f9c9fa3917443cd9b and selection evidence:sha256:736b00dc2fbe8f2db02b3d4072c975e489c7d1a88526a86a170bc2cdbe1f6e55. Counts of 38 selected versus older 230 are different candidates, not a matched speedup. Missing comparisons become precise required evidence; settled model work is not reacquired.

Sole owner of the payback acceptance and promotion decision. This row absorbs the still-open measured-promotion obligation; consolidation grants no completion or evidence credit. call-reach owns implementation and its one pre-existing broad integration run. Evaluate its retained baseline/candidate records through this row's verifier once: actual expensive work avoided, seeded relevant failures detected, original receipt inputs and provenance, complete outcomes and total measured cost. No second audit row, broad-suite replay or model acquisition for unchanged records. Missing or stale evidence becomes the specific outstanding acquisition or affected repair, never an invented pass. Use the existing evidence and admission owners; the independent acceptance criteria remain fixed.

The first adoption decision covers the bounded implementation slice produced by call-reach, without requiring every historical opportunity below. One existing dependency owner supplies compilation inputs, required behavioral checks and receipt invalidation; remove the displaced competing rule when migrating consumers. Bind analysis results to relevant source/build/toolchain/environment identities. Freeze a representative mutation set before candidate selection; retain expected outcomes and the existing evaluator independently. Require zero missed seeded regressions and zero stale successful receipts in that declared set, with useful net elapsed savings including analysis, preparation, failed attempts and finalization. Exercise unrelated source/test changes, relevant fixture/callee changes, init/build-tag effects and unresolved calls. Reuse successful independent checks after sibling failure and restart; skipped or unfinished checks receive no credit. Keep required recompilation when behavioral retesting is excluded. A changed required contract reopens only its affected obligations. Gate-policy changes are accepted under the pre-existing scope. Compare the actual expensive group before and after; package-count reduction without saved work is insufficient. Preserve broad fallback with a reason only for unresolved reachable effects. A refused candidate leaves the current selector active and records the next specific obligation. After the first useful adoption, return to the next model bundle before expanding analysis or browser selection.

Retained acceptance requirements and incident evidence:

Compare cold and resumed attempts over the same docs/plan-only, browser, unit-test, runtime fixture, model-execution, kernel and gate-policy change matrix. Inject regressions and refuse any selection that misses a failure detected by the retained required scope. Measure wall to commit, preparation/queue/check/finalization time, executed/reused packages, model loads, outstanding checks and interventions. The 91537691 gate took 1270.6 seconds and executed 234 packages with zero reuse. Hatchet merge fd3a3250 took 1080.7 seconds with 7 reused and 226 executed packages; 154 opaque readers retained broad scope. The preceding browser failure took 925.1 seconds with 233 executed and zero reused packages. Use these concrete incidents, not a universal throughput floor. Publish through existing gate cost/evidence owners. Include merge snapshot preparation: this intake copies a source store with 117099 blobs; measure copying, syncing and replay before choosing immutable snapshot reuse or incremental backup. Preserve verified store ancestry and crash integrity. No recurring full benchmark merely to validate gate savings. Adoption may proceed independently of the modality report; broader batching still retains its recovery and promotion prerequisites. Prioritize ordinary documentation and plan edits: target seconds-scale publication and measure the ratio against the 1006.894-second documentation incident; 100x is an operator optimization target, not permission to omit required checks or a claimed result. Separate prose/assets from embedded inputs, fixtures, generated contracts and executable policy. Remove the recurring requirement to edit Go task-ID lists for routine plan additions while retaining substantive campaign constraints. Resolve non-Go consumer ownership before narrowing lanes; file extensions alone cannot authorize exclusion. Include preparation and finalization in the comparison. Make browser acceptance granular through the existing webui-lane -run selector: bind each journey to its component/route, shared shell, JavaScript/CSS dependencies and consumed HTTP contracts. Shared authentication, session and protocol changes widen to their consumers; unresolved reach retains the complete lane. Reuse independent scenario receipts across sibling failure and restart. Bind each selector to its owning package and refuse missing, skipped or zero-match targets. Prepare browser/server/model/GPU resources only for selected journeys that consume them. No second UI scheduler, policy list or receipt authority. Compare selected and full runs with seeded component, navigation and authentication regressions before adoption. Eliminate routine report-Markdown regeneration as a source of unrelated gate invalidation: consume existing typed report identities, distinguish a requested rendered view from authoritative state, and demonstrate unchanged evidence remains reusable. Preserve frozen long-form corpus identities when documentation changes; do not silently change an accepted corpus. Treat scheduling overlap separately from reduced test scope: record actual total cost and unchanged check coverage, and do not credit the browser/package overlap as solved opaque-input selection or package-evidence reuse.

Landed documentation measurement: 7367a3f8 completed the README and plan publication gate in 87.434 seconds, versus 153.329 seconds for 7589ed77. Runtime package, GPU and browser executions were all zero; modern-Go 17.901 seconds, bound acceptance 7.623 seconds, document checks 6.577 seconds and finalization 12.213 seconds. No competing analysis probes were run by this session during the measurement. This improves elapsed cost but does not meet the seconds-scale target. Gate-policy adoption 857fef83 took 1410.360 seconds after the browser contention repair, with 230 package executions and zero reuse; address the measured source-scope invalidation and static-analysis cost before claiming broad development-speed improvement. Preserve MiniCPM captures across these automation-only changes.

Current master measurement 959b9d6f: the accepted census/browser change still selected 158 direct and 72 dependent packages, with 191 opaque readers, 230 executed packages and zero reused receipts. Two preceding attempts exposed actual browser regressions; use those concrete counterexamples in the selection replay. A fast selector must retain the manifest-refresh, navigation and fixture-isolation failures while avoiding unrelated model acquisition. Include audio intake changes to resident sampling, decoder cleanup, shared MLP backward and optimizer progress as distinct mutation cases. Compare closure preparation and metadata generation cost as well as test duration; retained evidence and immutable source snapshots should be reused through existing owners.

Confirmed retry-policy gap: internal/gate.phaseReusesEvidence excludes the whole device and webui lanes. The audio merge's unchanged-source retry therefore repeats those lanes even though independent correctness checks passed. Separate reusable correctness receipts from timing/isolation-dependent measurements in the existing gate, device/browser runners and test-evidence owners. A reusable receipt must bind actual compiled dependencies, artifact/fixture identities, protocol/tolerances, toolchain, backend/driver/device identity and resolved environment; source equality alone is insufficient. Missing/changed inputs, skips, failed outcomes and unresolved ownership grant no credit. Preserve successful independent packages from a failed group without manufacturing a combined pass. Validate against this exact missing-corpus incident and deliberate fixture/backend/source mutations, then measure saved wall time and acquisitions before adoption. Do not simply add device/webui to a blanket phase whitelist or create a second cache/framework.

Master merge 25835603 is complete with parents 959b9d6f and 99cdcd8d; the committed plan is identical to the first parent. Accepted gate: 1908.1 seconds wall time, device 18m5.836s, dependent-package stage 8m43.506s, browser 1m45.381s, 230 executed packages and no reused receipts. The two failed gates plus the accepted gate total 3857.4 seconds, before merge preparation and focused repair checks. Keep these full-attempt costs in the payback comparison. The device correctness group passed before a separate measurement group; distinguish their contracts and reuse eligibility. Short-lane skips grant no dependent-fixture credit and do not replace required device acceptance. A post-merge source audit finds 155 directly opaque roots; the gate's 191-reader count includes its wider selected graph. Do not conflate those denominators.

The first attribution gate spent 905.8 seconds before Go stopped the owner package at its default aggregate 600-second timeout. Static and bound acceptance passed; device-wide and browser phases had not begun. The active batch-declaration test passed alone in 23.609 seconds. Concurrent lane merges were running during the failed attempt; preserve that resource context without asserting it explains every elapsed second. Remove avoidable serialization of isolated fixtures, retain completed checks, and distinguish aggregate suite exhaustion from an individual assertion failure or stalled test. Any later deadline-control change must preserve operator ceilings, cancellation and stuck-work detection through existing test-evidence/process owners; do not merely raise a fixed timeout or install another supervisor. Attribution must be captured before candidate teardown clears the input graph. Test the complete handoff with frozen input identity and parseable output, not just the formatter in isolation.

Rank savings only from actual execution evidence: package/check start, completed/failed/interrupted outcome and measured elapsed time. Use existing Go JSON and run-record owners; preserve unstarted planned work as unstarted, never assign it the duration of its phase. Keep summed parallel package duration separate from wall time. The current longest-phase attribution is scope context only. Bind each proposed exclusion to its full changed-input-to-check path and demonstrate that no compiler, environment, protocol or other runtime invalidator independently requires re-execution. Compare structural helper-boundary simplification with narrow analysis on the same expensive consumer and acceptance mutations before choosing further analysis investment.

Include checkable applicability and reuse certificates in the existing machine-readable report/evidence owners. Demonstrate a relevant mutation invalidates the certificate and selects its failing consumer, an unrelated mutation preserves the receipt, and an unresolved reachable effect retains required coverage. Record analysis and certificate-validation cost against actual saved execution; a diagram or missing graph path alone grants no evidence credit.

Automatic composition extends automationcheck.ManifestPlan, the existing dependency resolver and receipt owners. Derive required checks and their prerequisites from the cumulative candidate changes; keep compiler obligations separate from behavioral execution. Emit a machine-readable reason path for each selected check, matching reusable receipt or specific invalidator, and scoped unresolved boundary. Compose cheap refusal barriers before expensive work and independent checks under existing resource admission. No model-generated exemption or second scheduler. Measure each additional rule against the already accepted selector as well as the retained original matrix; preserve exact receipts for unchanged checks across additions. Adoption remains under the pre-existing gate and frozen counterexamples.

Verification recipes: orchestrate gates with the same compile, bind, admit, execute and record discipline as model recipes. Compile a deterministic, content-addressed DAG from the cumulative source change and resolved impact through automationcheck.Plan/ManifestPlan; bind each invocation to its check definition, actual inputs, environment, dependencies, resources and unchanged acceptance. Reuse the existing recipe artifact kind, execution authority, DAG runner, gate and run-record owners rather than adding a parallel recipe framework. Persist the composed recipe before execution and resume outstanding nodes after interruption. A newly composed whole-plan identity does not by itself invalidate a completed node whose relevant definition, inputs and acceptance still match; preserve its original provenance and bind reuse explicitly into the new recipe. Changes after freezing create a successor recipe and reopen only affected obligations. Keep unresolved input boundaries explicit, preparation demand-driven, cheap checks ahead of expensive checks and resource release attached to node lifetime. Acceptance covers deterministic composition, dependency closure, recipe tampering, relevant and unrelated mutations, cross-recipe exact reuse, sibling failure, restart and cancellation; retain existing full policy acceptance before adoption. Dynamic composition selects and binds approved checks; it cannot generate weaker assertions or new acceptance thresholds.

Static-analysis granularity: distinguish phase selection from analysis scope. Current formatting uses changed Go files, while vet invokes ./... and the modern-Go census inspects the broader source snapshot. Measure executed analysis work before choosing the first reduction. Reuse immutable per-file syntax results where rules are file-local; type/call checks include the affected package and proven dependent closure; repository aggregates retain their complete invariant using exact unchanged contributions. Bind analyzer/rule version, file/package inputs, compiler/build tags, environment and policy data. Cover edits, additions, removals, renames, import/API changes, generated inputs, policy changes and restart with seeded failures against the full analyzer. Unknown effects retain broad scope. Report analyzed/reused units and actual wall/compute cost; a changed-file trigger does not prove changed-file-only execution. Adopt one useful real reduction before extending analysis; retain the existing full gate until its acceptance passes. Touched-file literal review follows owning contracts and independent fixtures; it does not justify a second global scan.

Measured test-only case: commit 3e6bf83a changed cmd/diffusion/main_test.go plus the plan and gate-owned census outputs, yet executed 230 packages with zero reuse; scope reported 191 opaque runtime readers. Use its retained gate execution records as a concrete over-selection witness. Separate changed test inputs, generated census inputs and unresolved production reads when explaining each selection. Demonstrate one legitimate exclusion with seeded relevant failures before broad adoption; changing only the trigger or suppressing an unknown reader is not proof.

This is the single payback decision for the first reduction. Compare complete commits on the same task/source changes, including cold analysis, incremental analysis, cache lookup, retries, device/model loading, verification, publication and interventions. Confirm checks actually avoided execution, not merely moved phases. Refusal is a valid recorded decision with reason and revisit trigger; it does not unlock dependent implementation as an accepted exclusion. A next candidate requires a new causal hypothesis, not repeated unchanged acquisition. In the adoption commit, rank the next incomplete model bundle ahead of optional general analysis and convenience steps unless measured costs show a specific remaining blocker. The next bundle uses accepted savings without waiting for graph expansion.

steps.title: Remove one duplicated automation API or executable with its callers
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: remove a duplicated public API or executable and migrate its callers. bounded-reduction owns the next expensive runtime-reader/fixture dependency. Select disjoint deliverables or explicitly reuse the same retained proof; never create a second implementation or repeat a broad suite to satisfy the second row.

Remove one enumerated duplicated automation responsibility through its existing owner, migrating all callers and deleting the displaced implementation in the same batch. Use retained cost and caller graphs; do not repeat a repository inventory. Compare this dependency repair with deeper analysis on the same expensive consumer, and consume the first reduction's exact evidence if it already removes the selected owner. Candidate boundaries include operation -> plan optional Lease/Effect handling, whose inspected production constructors set neither field, and recipe -> loop imports for breaker/rollback/promote/reenter. These are hypotheses: prove all writers, aliases and consumers before removal. Other eligible bounded duplicates are process-execution allowances, converter mappings, VQA decode setup and resize ownership. Choose one at dispatch. Freeze success/refusal/cancellation/restart/persistence contracts, public compatibility and all Go/script/plan/release consumers. Preserve intentional differences with explicit inputs and independent counterexamples; similarity or file size is not equivalence. Remove obsolete exports, forwarding wrappers, command/build entries and duplicate policy decisions. A temporary compatibility alias needs a named consumer migration and retirement trigger. Use existing apimanifest/report owners, including optional sequence views generated from the same proven graph. Record exports, wrappers, commands, shipped binaries and duplicated decisions separately, with compile/link cost and artifact size. Reject increased dependency fan-out or total verification cost without measured compensating benefit. Binary count alone proves neither consolidation nor cheaper model validation. Retain the current gate and listed lower-bound checks; this row grants no new exclusion. Automation cleanup is independent of broad modality work; numerical/public-contract changes keep their specific regression and lane prerequisites. Pass the exact caller/removal inventory to simplify-command-surface instead of repeating it.

Concrete dependency case: scratchmodel's input-admission repair selected the whole audioparity integration suite through audioparity test imports -> internal/server -> internal/modelbuilder -> internal/scratchmodel. Its executed package cost was 7m43.721s before a missing-fixture failure; cmd/evaluate and cmd/recipe have no compiler path to scratchmodel. Compare separating the server's optional model-construction dependency with bounded per-test reach proof before adding analysis machinery. Preserve affected server/construction and native training coverage; an import trace alone does not authorize exclusion. Use retained suite-cost evidence:sha256:33fa52aca29394023cedc865f12a29dbec53ab30b73ce397ab243b2f6152a5f2 for execution attribution, including failure and cancellation rather than crediting all planned tests.

steps.title: Reuse unchanged verification nodes across composed recipes
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: this step owns reuse of successful immutable node evidence across different recipe compositions. It does not own within-run acceptance/owner coalescing (shared-execution) or resuming saved selections (prepared-resume). Use their existing receipts and graph representation rather than a new runner or cache.

Follow the first expensive-work reduction unless this specific cache defect demonstrably blocks its frozen target. The in-progress source-evidence-binding repair remains separate and keeps its current verifier and identity. Bound the first dynamic verification-recipe improvement to reuse and provenance, independently of finer call-reach exclusions. Existing automationcheck.Plan, ManifestPlan and BindManifestExecution already compose and bind the DAG. At producer 3abc5e1c an in-memory probe ran the same definition and resolved inputs twice under two different plan identities: executions=2, reuse=0. Ordinary gate phases use that bound invocation as their cache slot; checkpoint/package memo paths need explicit review before claiming the same defect there. Inspect existing owners and any committed lane repair first. Extend their admission/cache/evidence path, migrate callers and remove displaced identity policy; no new scheduler or recipe registry. Preserve distinct execution authorization for each recipe and immutable original result provenance. Prove a successful matching node can be referenced by a successor recipe without fabricating current-plan evidence for the original evidence ID. Changed check definition, actual inputs, environment or acceptance must rerun; failures, unclassified skips and missing bindings grant no credit. Keep current required check selection and phase eligibility unchanged, including full gate-policy acceptance. Exercise actual gate handoff and final commit admission, tampered reuse lineage, relevant and unrelated changes, restart, sibling failure and cancellation. Demonstrate saved executions and total cost on a real eligible check before adoption; the synthetic probe alone is not a payback claim. Include mechanical preparation nodes where their exact source/tool/derived-output binding permits reuse rather than unconditional regeneration. Record whole-attempt cost and avoid repeated model acquisition. Preserve the probe source/result in the existing finding/evidence owner; scripts in tmp are diagnostic, not completion authority.

Retained counterexample: evidence:sha256:9c1a1d497af0a0c9f94e7e7f76e91ee5ee8cdda77f5e35afeb5308e96881ebcf records two executions and zero reuse for unchanged check definitions and inputs across distinct manifest identities. Preserve the original result authority when binding successor authorization; relabeling an old result is not valid reuse. The synthetic counterexample does not prove current phase fingerprints complete: style reads a comparison baseline, formatting selects planned paths, and architecture reads staged-surface and structure policy. Bind each real check's actual baseline, selection, policy and execution inputs before removing manifest-wide invalidation. Unresolved checks retain their existing binding. Demonstrate one eligible real check with baseline/path/policy mutation counterexamples; do not enable every nominally cacheable phase merely by changing its key.

Input-binding counterexamples: evidence:sha256:c34204d9cf56780535cee88b7f0d07ff4f45d325387c35ae341ebf1c1b824bcd. A format selection change turns a real pass into failure without changing the current phase fingerprint; profile inputs omit docs/clone_baseline.json. Current whole-plan binding prevents unsafe reuse. Retain both executable witnesses before adoption. Bind selected paths, consumed policy files and relevant HEAD source baseline; distinguish original result identity from authorization to reuse it under a successor plan. Do not remove the plan key for unaudited checks.

steps.title: Construct verification DAGs from resolved impact obligations
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: compose existing check obligations and edges; do not reimplement the shared-census product, receipt reuse or lane scheduler. Freeze one real mutation matrix and derive the graph and diagrams from the same facts. Expand composition only for a demonstrated remaining selection error or cost.

Extend existing ManifestPlan/ExecuteDAG and gate selection; no new recipe engine, command or policy registry. Consume the first adopted impact boundary and compile stable obligation IDs plus current dependencies, acceptance, environment and resource demands into a deterministic DAG. Deduplicate the same obligation requested by multiple rows; never equate different assertions merely because coverage overlaps. Order ready cheap refusal/static/contract checks ahead of expensive work using recorded execution cost; overlap independent work within capacity and retain required critical escalation. Current scope, claims, stops, store and candidate identity are live admission, not cacheable decisions. Failed nodes block their dependents while unrelated authorized work remains eligible. Generate optional sequence views from these exact edges and events, distinguishing possible branches, observed calls and concurrent order; no handwritten diagram facts or Markdown artifacts. Acceptance covers deterministic composition, graph/recipe tampering, independent duplicate obligations, changed/unaffected tests, unknown effects, cycles, resource contention, cancellation/restart, successor-recipe reuse with original provenance, and a real commit whose long checks survive an unrelated late static repair. Use recipe-node-reuse output if available; do not implement a second cache. If measured-adoption refused, replan a supported boundary before this row dispatches.

Use Colibri integration 25889dac as an additional execution case: result evidence:sha256:a7edbffb3bd71c5552576d1ce7f68e9dfa8768678a1ab25b148cb7cd3225d587; costs evidence:sha256:676991388b3568387e433f830bb1b633abb4d5f4250c4f74ec6f3f69d94db44f; selection evidence:sha256:f2cada1dc4a63c547d1555e1a2b0ac6beaf75b191181c56acb54fb6f8dd0bb44. The gate selected 163 packages, with 191 opaque readers. Audio parity passed in 7m17.785s; one observed process working set was 67494998016 bytes while real baseline and training acceptance ran concurrently. This is an observation, not an isolated memory peak or a regression claim. Before excluding any audio acceptance, resolve its actual changed run-record, inference and protocol dependencies. Compare exact receipt reuse, narrower proven assertion scope and shared immutable fixtures with scheduling changes; preserve native correctness, caller isolation and all outstanding checks. Do not repeat the acquisition solely to refresh this cost example.

steps.title: Reuse shared static analysis with rule-specific invalidation
steps.rationale:
Combined-plan boundary: shared-census owns the first census computation. This step considers one remaining analyzer/rule consumer only after inspecting that result; reuse its source/type product and invalidation contract. Do not repeat its implementation or payback audit. A complete measured no-benefit decision is acceptable; missing evidence is not.

Choose the measured highest-cost overlapping static computation after the first reduction. Reuse existing parsing, type information and census owners. Run file-local rules on changed files; package rules on the affected package/dependent closure; update global invariants using unchanged cached contributions plus edits/additions/removals. Bind source, analyzer/rule version, Go/toolchain, tags/platform, baselines/exceptions, generated policy and selected paths. Separate pure analysis from current policy/time admission. Fuse repeated scans only where their inputs agree. Delete duplicate rule execution only with an explicit assertion-subsumption argument and independently retained counterexamples; overlapping line coverage is insufficient. Acceptance compares incremental and full outputs for rename/delete/import/API/generated/policy/environment mutations and restart, with seeded violations and measured analyzed/reused units and whole-attempt cost. A more complex cache without positive payback is refused.

Reuse go/parser, go/ast and go/types data in the current analysis owner; these provide syntax/types, not a complete call/effect proof. Declare environment, directory membership and missing-file observations as inputs; use io/fs and fstest.MapFS for pure file-contract tests while retaining real filesystem durability tests. A narrow store-seam rule detects retained-campaign tests opening roots.Store outside the reference-store owner; isolated temporary stores remain valid. Keep that rule's assertion identity in the shared preflight once accepted. Bounded built-in fuzz exploration can discover parser/schema/graph counterexamples; persist minimized failures as corpus tests and independently retain oracle expectations. Ordinary verification replays the applicable corpus, not unbounded exploration. The sampler/tokenizer/server fuzz owners already exist; extend them only for an affected measured gap. For numerics, cheap shape/dtype/bounds assertions and independently derived small references can discharge structural obligations; neither algebra over real numbers nor shared generated expectations proves floating-point or native-kernel parity.

Account for retained AST/type/census memory as well as scan wall. Prefer one immutable analysis product per matching input set, compact projections and explicit release after consumers finish. Do not multiply complete graphs per rule/process or keep an unbounded cache. Report cold/resumed peak process-tree memory and bytes analyzed/reused with the existing cost owner.

steps.title: Resolve runtime paths and commands across one real call boundary
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestRuntimeInputsUnsafeClassifications|TestRuntimeInputsPropagateThroughCallers|TestRuntimeInputsIndirectAndConditional|TestRuntimeReachBindingsAcceptance|TestChangeSelectionRequiredMatrix)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/runtime_value_flow_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestRuntimeValueFlowAcceptance$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Optional follow-on after the first adopted reduction. Dispatch only for a named unresolved effect whose expected saved work exceeds the added analysis and verification cost; it is not an admission prerequisite for the first reduction. Extend the same dependency result only where the first live boundary still loses information. Follow path and command values through parameters, returns, receiver fields and bound callbacks; propagate conservative unions at conditional/loop joins. Distinguish temporary/external fixture roots from candidate repository inputs, including subprocess working directories and constructed argv. items.title: Overlap eligible checks without extending next-gate waiting

steps.title: Schedule lanes against the same frozen candidate
steps.rationale:
Owners: existing gate DAG, deferred execution, resource and lifecycle paths. After prepared resume, compare post-commit launch with eligible lanes starting after required static/owner checks while independent host tests run. Model data, failure-order and resource dependencies; no blanket dependency removal or new scheduler. Bind the same immutable candidate and preserve obligations across publication and late failures. Ordinary correctness uses shared GPU admission; declared performance measurements retain exclusivity. Shorten worktree/store lock scope only when existing snapshots and CAS publication prove safety. Cover host failure with active lanes, cancellation, contention, concurrent publishers, process death and obsolete results. Measure all-check completion, repeated work and next-gate waiting; an earlier commit alone is not a win.

Concurrency must fit measured whole-request RAM and VRAM demand including resident models, transient allocations and child processes. Use gate-resource-efficiency measurements and existing resource admission to bound concurrency from available capacity; do not assume parallelism reduces total cost. Shared correctness work remains eligible when it fits; exclusive GPU access is reserved for declared isolation requirements. Unknown demand permits a conservative explainable schedule, never unlimited fan-out or false acceptance. Test release-triggered waiting, cancellation, holder exit and normal parallel-worktree contention; compare peak memory, queue time and all-check completion. No new scheduler or arbitrary fixed worker/memory ceiling.

items.title: Declare the denominator and validate existing modality capabilities

steps.rationale:
Implement one bounded media acquisition-to-report slice through existing run-record, execution, candidate and compatibility owners. The typed protocol binds inputs, source/overlay, model/data identities, frozen assertions, units, budget and publication outputs. Discover completed acquisitions before loading a model; checkpoint each cell and make evidence/report publication idempotent. Force restart before and after acquisition, record commit and projection publication; recover the unfinished transition with no duplicate model load or mutation. Include rejected candidates, duplicate observations, exact result reuse, budget exhaustion and missing-resource waits with explicit resumption triggers. Measure total elapsed/compute/loading/verification/recovery/intervention cost against the current same-task workflow. Keep output generation in existing compatibility owners and migrate the concrete temporary publishers this slice replaces. Split at the first owning boundary if implementation cannot fit one bounded batch; no new general experiment framework and no prerequisite on the whole modality campaign.

Split this first boundary from broader experiment orchestration if necessary.

First acquisition boundary is split into exact-replay-before-open. items.title: Reduce recurring build and gate cost, then simplify dispatch and publication

steps.title: Publish a plan edit through the gate with one command
steps.rationale:
Independently of gate-wall optimization, remove repeated manual authoring through the existing cmd/plan and gate composition owners. First inventory current plan-edit, publication, scope and completion helpers. Extend one existing operation and remove displaced orchestration; do not copy gate policy into a convenience wrapper or spawn a new executable. The operation derives the publication row and structure verifier, consumes operator message text, delegates canonical scope admission and publication to the gate, and lets the gate own atomic plan advancement. Acceptance: TestPlanPublishCommand verifies exact plan/message/path binding, current scope refusal, successful advancement and restart without duplicate publication. Failure preserves the operator edit and unrelated work; keep failed evidence and owned recovery obligations rather than pretending all durable state is unchanged. Cleanup or rollback may touch only operation-owned artifacts after concurrent-change checks. Measure operator edit-to-commit cost and record removed helper/API paths. Preserve required admission, docs and acceptance contracts. Dispatch after the retained-cost measurement only; no prerequisite on memoization, checkpoint repair, measured adoption or consolidation. It is independently useful for reducing operator work and failed publication attempts, and is not a prerequisite to model progress or the expensive-test reduction.

Share cheap scope/readiness results with dispatch-readiness instead of maintaining a second implementation. Detect the exact plan-only dirty-source refusal before costly admission, using the canonical owner. Never prescribe stash or moving unrelated work as an automatic publication step. Keep this operation independently deliverable after measure; command-help, frontier diagnostics, stop-state, metadata and the full analysis stack are not added prerequisites.

Observed publication repairs: a resolved owned stash conflict left AUTO_MERGE and REUC index metadata. Diagnose these before expensive work; only retire orphan metadata after proving no active merge or unresolved entries and preserving the exact index tree. Never clear another operation's merge state. Use the existing gate -preflight -paths entry point for exact validation; cmd/preflight covers a different set. Consolidate or clearly partition these existing entry points through command discovery, without another wrapper.

Include generated outputs in the gate-owned staging transaction before candidate freeze; regenerate only invalidated outputs. Prove a late deterministic repair cannot leave ambiguous MM state or cause a second manual regeneration path. Bind clean-source verification to the gate-authorized prospective candidate commit where supported, with exact tree/index/content matching and rejection after mutation; never accept an arbitrary dirty worktree by suppressing CleanRevision. Coordinate the existing modelintake and browser owners without importing their feature work.

The merged Library journey reproduces CleanRevision's candidate limitation: it downloads/registers and serves the real projector-backed model, but validation reports completed=false for the dirty-source refusal. Preserve that scope honestly. Candidate-bound verification remains open; a journey that accepts the refusal is not end-to-end model validation.

Tests cover two master checkouts, master-to-lane and lane-to-master, source advance during preparation, first-parent-target plan retention, harness baseline conflict, conflicted-plan resolution before Save/claim validation, restart/idempotence and separate source/target stores. Remove the need for checkout-ours, overlays, tmp mirror programs and hand-inserted merge rows; do not introduce another merge framework.

This is the sole lane-merge automation obligation; prioritize it when an integration is pending, without making it a prerequisite to model validation. Include the current GUI master-to-lane intake alongside image/video as a portability case. The lane retains its own open work and owner stop; merge preparation cannot dispatch either campaign.

At mutation admission recheck current state under the existing ownership. Recheck plan/claim revision at mutation. Acceptance includes two distinct rows and owners that overlap internal/gate, same-worker reentry, separate worktrees and an unaffected ready row. Preserve all independently required assertions when consolidating measured-adoption, common-owner-pilot and recipe-node-reuse; deduplicate only exact obligation identities, not different tests covering similar lines. The standard-library pilots and cheap preflight do not wait for this representation migration.

Move the applicable closeout-coverage invariant into the existing semantic plan owner used by edit/Save and tests. items.title: Reuse immutable evidence without copying every small file

steps.title: Measure and decide whether to pack small immutable records
steps.rationale:
The current evidence descriptor census includes 68385 text/plain records totaling 10801019 bytes, 27609 closure-ledger records totaling 29217663 bytes, and 1070 code-manifest-analysis records totaling 1110797445 bytes. Descriptor counts include retained content not necessarily stored as separate blobs; keep physical and logical denominators separate. Reuse the existing OvergoDB segment/index owners. Measure publication, reopen, random lookup, backup and concurrent-writer costs with actual size distributions. A retained-layout decision may close this row with evidence and a reopen trigger; packing is not mandatory. Use operator-facing versus automation-internal roles to rank redundant binaries and APIs by real callers, not suffix or the historical 102 count. Public help/discovery repairs can land independently; binary deletion still requires the caller migration and contract evidence below. Require a capability-scoped removal result. Consume the early common-owner inventory; rank remaining duplicate APIs and shipped command binaries by repeated build, verification, startup, packaging and maintenance cost. Before dispatch choose a concrete duplicated owner and bind the old-to-new caller/operation map. Migrate code, automation, installation/release manifests and human references in the same integration batch; remove the displaced implementation, exports and build target. A dispatcher over unchanged handlers can earn measured packaging/discovery savings, but cannot satisfy this row's ownership-consolidation acceptance without removing duplicated implementation or policy. Keep compatibility shims only for declared external callers with an explicit retirement obligation. Gate public/numerical changes by affected contracts; do not make unrelated catalog validation a new prerequisite for the early internal automation pilot.

Consume the common-owner-pilot's call/effect and caller-migration map. Rank remaining parallel paths by duplicated policy and measured maintenance/verification cost, not textual clones alone. Separate actual shared responsibility from numerical, lifecycle or protocol differences. Consolidate one capability at a time, migrate consumers and delete displaced APIs in the same batch; avoid combining unrelated helpers merely to reduce package count. Keep all existing regression, modality, benchmark and recovery prerequisites for this broader public-surface work.

Inventory actual overlapping wrappers rather than assume a fixed command count. Fold probe/lane/parity entrypoints into typed subcommands only where ownership/maintenance cost falls; preserve every behavior, flag contract, exit code and evidence path. Preserve plan, gate, loop and hook responsibilities and their required invocation contracts; separate binaries are justified by actual consumer, isolation or lifecycle requirements, not historical names alone. Atomically update plan verifiers, CI, scripts, API manifest and docs with an old-to-new invocation map; no later row may reference a removed command. Keep README's transport descriptions aligned with registered adapters. Validate all migrated invocation contracts plus representative real dispatch and record the reduced command/duplication ceilings. Avoid rerunning expensive model suites when an exact implementation-independence proof permits evidence reuse. Consolidate only shared responsibilities whose callers can migrate atomically with lower measured maintenance cost; distinct responsibilities remain separate. Command-count reduction alone is not acceptance.

Select the first consolidation from measured duplicated responsibilities in model lookup, admission, input resolution or evidence publication. Freeze the caller/contract inventory and before cost; migrate every affected caller, remove the displaced implementation and prove equivalent success/refusal/exit/evidence behavior through TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts in internal/apimanifest. Assert that generated invocation references resolve and duplicate ownership cannot reappear. A renamed executable or a new dispatcher around unchanged duplication is insufficient.

Align skill.md durable automation policy with the campaign decision: the second manual repetition triggers review of the existing owner, not mandatory creation of another command. Prefer removal of manual work or extension of an existing typed operation; require demonstrated recurring need and explicit ownership before admitting a new public entrypoint. Preserve deterministic verification and durable receipts. Include this policy alignment and net surface/caller accounting in the same bounded consolidation; broader HTTP implementation remains GUI-owned.

Include the landed providerintake, remoteprovider, remoterelay and modelrecipe admission paths in the ownership census. Consolidate duplicated model lookup, credentials or admission only when measured duplication and atomic caller migration justify it; keep provider declaration, credential storage and wire transport responsibilities explicit. Coordinate HTTP caller migration with the GUI lane. Do not add a new public wrapper or defer E4B to perform this cleanup.

The earlier evidence-commit-recovery slice owns narrowly necessary gate-wrapper removal; consume its ownership map rather than inventory or implement it again. This later row handles only remaining measured duplication. Delete displaced retry, timeout, input-resolution and evidence-publication policy with all callers; require end-to-end success/refusal/cancellation/exit/evidence parity and lower ownership/surface cost. Do not add wrapper-count targets or a new registry.

Audit automatic Markdown writers and their readers in benchmark-report, compatibility (model/media/training), api-manifest, plan sync, preflight and release. Prefer existing typed JSON/OvergoDB results as the single operational authority; machine consumers must not scrape prose. Remove stray generated plans/status/handoffs and redundant report persistence with all callers, while retaining deliberate human documentation and third-party model cards/licenses. Keep optional report rendering explicit. Audit follow-up and sequencing: consume the CLI boundary, consumer-rule proof and early owner pilot. At first dispatch split remaining work into capability-sized implementation steps with one acceptance/integration owner each; retain this parent and its prerequisites until all assigned migrations are accounted for. Rank one command family by measured repeated build, execution, verification and operator cost; do not launch a 102-to-40 binary campaign or treat that estimate as a floor. Candidates are database maintenance, lane execution, declared training probes, and format/model tools. Select shared responsibility, dependencies and lifecycle before command spelling. Avoid a giant train or preflight binary that forces unrelated native/GPU backends into every invocation. CPU-only tools and deliberate process/privilege boundaries stay separate when needed.

Database maintenance must reuse canonical transaction, integrity and recovery owners while preserving operation-specific read/write access, CRC/chain validation, crash recovery, backup consistency and concurrent readers. Combining command names does not repair unsafe rebuild/swap or repair paths. Reproduce and correct any real integrity defect with its immediate persistence acceptance; it does not wait for the larger consolidation. Lane migration shares real skip/zero-match/evidence/cancellation policy while retaining distinct resource and protocol requirements. Training probes may share declared dispatch without acquiring every training backend; preserve their actual production paths and independent acceptance.

HTTP remains GUI-owned. Before any route removal or advertisement change, bind the actual launcher/provider path, real consumers and external compatibility claim in the existing route/API manifest owner. Distinguish operational, implemented-but-unwired, compatibility-required and retired surfaces; a missing provider or 501 response alone does not authorize deletion. A read-only disposition can proceed independently of model evidence; public behavior changes retain their affected prerequisites. No fixed route-count target.

Preserve or explicitly retire unfinished inference/session/cache, training, transport and agent recovery obligations through existing staged-surface authority; never claim deletion as capability validation.

Use cheap Go handler/constructor cases for sampler/provider/admission contracts and focused JavaScript/browser cases for camera/abort wiring; do not force model acquisition for pure UI cleanup. Consolidate route/consumer and capability/action declarations in existing manifest owners, with typed required interfaces, strict boundary decoding plus semantic validation and independently retained behavior cases. Derive client-call facts from supported JS analysis; unresolved dynamic calls retain explicit coverage. Go AST analysis alone cannot prove JS behavior. Avoid another hand-maintained declaration table or generated DESIGN.md freshness gate.
